name: Throne-Spear Adjudicator
lore: A martial officer of the Radiant Hierarchies who treats every cross-faction incursion as a case requiring forceful ruling.
visualDescription: Tall ivory-gold armor, throne-wheel backpiece, long radiant spear, sapphire judgment core.
mapBehavior: Uses reach and zone denial to pin Titan movement.

scaling.campaign: Fixed mission bands; older cross-faction run-ins become easier as Titan level and gear rise.
scaling.eliteRemix: +10% damage, +1 tactical mechanic, not raw health sponge tuning.
scaling.endgame: Adds role synergy and objective pressure before raw hp increases.
scaling.levelFormula: hp and damage scale by mission band and device performance caps; mechanics are preferred over inflated health pools.

priority: pressure the lone Titan from its role
aiProfile.counterplayWindow: Major actions must telegraph through stance, landmark, or lane preview before impact.

balanceNotes: Cross-faction MELEE run-in tuned for one Titan vs many; lore pressure and role synergy first, raw stats second.

loreGuardrails.sourceCultureRule: source culture humans later copied as angelic and heavenly lore
loreGuardrails.forbidden: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.
